steps.note: CONVERTED (exact pass for the authoritative-priced subset): GET /provider now projects the SDK {all,default,connected,failed} body from the REAL provider catalog. Model objects carry cost.input/output/cache from the frozen quote lines in the SDK's published USD-per-million unit, limit.context/output from the real ModelCapabilities, api.{id,url,npm} from the configured family profile (published endpoint + AI-SDK package identity) and honest empty options/headers. EXCLUSION RULE: a model appears ONLY when its pricing state is authoritative (Known|ConservativeCeiling|LocalZero) AND the family profile attests the endpoint (openai: builtin Exact only; anthropic/google: any authoritative row on the fixed endpoint; ollama: LocalZero). PricingState::Unknown rows are NEVER flattened to zero — they are omitted (proved by crates/server/src/compat/sdk.rs tests: an Unknown-priced sibling is excluded while the Exact sibling is served byte-exact). release_date and status are OMITTED, not fabricated: the catalog carries neither a vendor release date nor alpha/beta/deprecated lifecycle (the SDK declares both required; omitting is the only honest option). default is empty (no provider-qualified default model exists in this runtime config); failed is empty (the registry exposes no failed-provider tracking); connected is the registry's registered provider instance ids (the daemon keeps no provider-credential store, so registration is its usable set, never a credential claim).

Exact pass: POST /pty now runs over the daemon's REAL PTY registry (AppState.ptys, the same faktor-pty authority the native session-owned terminal surface drives). The response is the SDK Pty object built from the values the spawn actually used: real id/pid, the requested command/args/cwd/title echoed, and status from the live child state (running for the interactive sh this trace creates); exitCode is omitted because the PTY backend exposes no exit-code authority (never fabricated), and sessionID is omitted because the SDK's create body carries no session id and no ownership row is minted. The pid is platform-normalized to @int in the golden; the rest of the shape is identical on the POSIX CI platforms.

Exact pass: DELETE /pty/{ptyID} terminates the real child process tree through the PTY backend's bounded shutdown (SIGTERM, grace, SIGKILL, reader join), drops the registry row and answers the SDK-declared boolean. This is the deterministic teardown of the terminal created by pty.create (the same id captured from its response).

Exact pass: GET /permission answers the SDK-declared bare PermissionRequest[] over the daemon's REAL pending permission requests (every class): capability -> permission, the requested target strings -> patterns, the full capability payload -> metadata, always [] because this slice keeps no always-allow rules.

Exact pass: GET /question answers the SDK-declared bare QuestionRequest[]. This slice has no structured-question subsystem — its question-class asks ARE permission requests and ride GET /permission — so the truthful projection is the empty array, never a fabricated question/option object.

Exact pass: GET /network answers the SDK-declared bare SessionNetworkWait[]. The SDK type is a network RECONNECT wait with a required creation time; the daemon has no reconnect-wait state (network-class asks ride GET /permission), so the truthful projection is the empty array, never a fabricated wait/timestamp.

CONVERTED (exact pass): GET /global/event now streams the SDK GlobalEvent union, projected from the DURABLE session journal plus the durable message/part rows and the live chunk sink, in journal order with the ring sequence as both SSE id and payload id. Projected members: session.created (journal SessionCreated + durable row), session.updated (durable row metadata mutation: the row is polled every cycle, and a title/provider/model change emits exactly one frame — the title-update path journals no event, so the row itself is the trigger), session.deleted (SessionEnded), session.turn.open (PromptReceived), session.turn.close (TurnCompleted on a park/terminal state), session.error (Failed), message.updated (durable user/assistant rows; system rows have no SDK Message variant), message.part.updated (durable text/reasoning rows + the durable user prompt text), session.next.text.delta / session.next.reasoning.delta (live chunk sink). LOCKED members (missing primitive named): SDK tool parts (the daemon persists bounded `excerpt` + artifact REFERENCES, never the full inline output/title/error the SDK ToolState declares, and stores tool_call and tool_result as SEPARATE rows, not the single stateful ToolPart), and every union member whose subsystem this daemon does not implement (pty.*, permission.*, question.*, sandbox.*, indexing.*, installation.*, MCP, worktree, ...). Frame corpus: compat/kilo-v756/sdk-global-frames.json (frames captured from the real projector; union_types pinned to the vendored types.gen.ts). The replay validates every live frame against that corpus (declared type + declared property keys) and requires at least one frame.
Exact pass: the SDK-declared 200: boolean true after every live session is durably ended (idempotent; an incomplete dispose is an error response, never false).
Exact pass: alias of /global/dispose; the SDK-declared boolean true after every live session is durably ended (idempotent).
Exact pass: the SDK-declared 200: boolean true after the idempotent crash-recovery sweep (recover()).
